artworks.title: Lady Algernon Percy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges

artworks.title: Saint Roch Carried to Heaven by Angels
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: This painting shows several people in the sky, surrounded by billowing fabric. In the center is a person who appears to be sitting on a cloud-like form. The person is on their back with their legs towards us and their head tilted up. They have short, curly hair and wear a garment of red and green cloth, with their arms raised upward above their head, their hands cupped together in a circular shape. On either side of them, three other people are partially visible, two to the left and one to the right. These people appear to be supporting the cloud and the central person, lifting them upwards. They have large blue and green wings with cloth draped around them, and no distinct facial features. One of the people on the left looks like a child, perhaps a cherub, although their upper body and head are blocked up the wings of the other person. What looks like the back of another person's head is visible in the bottom left. All of the people have pale skin. The background features a blue sky with streaks of cream and pink. The painting is enclosed within an oval shape and bordered in reddish-brown.

artworks.title: The Railway
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Horace Havemeyer in memory of his mother, Louisine W. Havemeyer
artworks.description: To our left, a young woman sits facing us on a low stone wall at the base of the vertical, black bars of an iron fence and a young girl stands facing away from us to our right in this horizontal painting. Both have pale skin. The woman looks directly at us with dark eyes as she holds an open book, a closed red fan, and a sleeping brown and white puppy in her lap. Her long auburn hair falls down over her shoulders. Her navy-blue dress is accented with white piping on the skirt, collar, and sleeves, and has three large, white buttons down the front and her black hat is adorned with two red poppies and a daisy. The girl wears a sleeveless white, knee-length dress belted with a marine-blue sash tied in a large bow at her back. The girl’s blond hair is pulled up and tied with a black ribbon. She raises her left hand to grasp the bar of the fence she faces. A bunch of green grapes lies on the low wall to our right. A plume of steam fills much of the space beyond the black fence, which spans the width of the painting and extends off the top edge. A few details can be made out beyond the fence, including a stone-gray building with two wooden doors to our left and a bridge along the right edge.

artworks.title: Victor Guye
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Nelson Cromwell
artworks.description: A young boy with pale skin, wearing a black suit with densely pattered gold trim and decoration, stands holding an open book in front of a brown background in this vertical portrait painting. His body is angled slightly to our right, but he looks at us with large, slate-blue eyes. He has a round face, a wide nose, and his full, peach-colored lips are barely parted. Short blond hair falls in tousled bangs across his forehead. A tall, oyster-white collar flares up in a wide V along the sides of his neck. His hip-length, long-sleeved black jacket has gold trim and decoration down the open front, along the bottom hem, and at the cuffs. His pants have a high waist, meeting the buttons of the white shirt at his chest. There are two gold buttons on his pants near the waist, framed by his open jacket. Gold trim continues down the sides of his long pants and around the leg openings. He wears black, loafer-style shoes with gray or white stockings or socks. He is lit from our left so casts a shadow to our right, in the dark brown room in which he stands.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: This painting shows the upper body of a person, focusing on their face and shoulders. The person is facing forward, looking directly at us. Their facial features include pale skin, large dark eyes, defined eyebrows, a straight nose, and a closed mouth with full, red lips. Their dark hair is styled on top of their head. The person is wearing a garment in shades of purple, with visible gold and white bands. Earrings with small dots of red and white hang from the ears. The painting is aged, with noticeable signs of wear and peeling occurring from the wood it was painted on, creating vertical lines and patches where the paint is no longer present.

artworks.title: Father and Son
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image displays two people from the waist up. The person on the left is seated in a green chair, facing slightly towards the viewer. They have short, light brown hair neatly combed to the side, a stern expression, noticeable cheeks, and a defined nose. They wear a tan coat with gold buttons over a black waistcoat and a white cravat. The person next to them, potentially a child, is slightly in front, facing the viewer, with hands clasped together or touching the object held by the other person. The child has very short light hair, a similar facial structure with bright eyes, and wears a dark garment with a white ruffled collar. The background features rich red drapery and a hint of a scenic landscape.

artworks.title: The Connecticut Valley
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting features a landscape with trees and foliage in dark greens, browns, and orange-red tones. In front of us, a steep mountain rises, covered with detailed trees in shades of green, orange, and yellow. Behind it, a river winds from left to right, the bank lined with more green trees and small white buildings, with several small white boats floating on the surface of the gray water. Behind the river are more mountains, some fading into the distance, painted in muted blues and greens. The blue sky has puffy clouds in shades of white, pale yellow, light gray, and darker gray.

artworks.title: Ark of the Covenant
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Ship "Arkansas" Leaving Havana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a maritime scene from the water, with a coastline in the distance marked by small, colorful buildings and distant green hills. Closer to us, a large ship with white sails floats on the green waves, flying the American flag and a flag that appears to have the word "Arkansas." Miniscule figures are visible on the deck of the ship, and thin ropes crisscross the three tall masts. On the left are two smaller ships. The one in the back flies a flag that says "Russia," while the closer ship near the bottom left corner has a design on the back that appears to say "Cuba." The sky above is bright blue, uninterrupted by clouds.

artworks.title: Catherine Brower
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image features a young girl standing facing the viewer. She holds a red flower in her right hand and a small bunch of pink flowers in her left hand. She has delicate features, light skin, long brown hair with bangs, and wears a white dress with blue sash. She wears red shoes, a black bead necklace, and an orange earring. Next to her is a pedestal with a vase of colorful flowers. The background shows a blue sky and trees.

artworks.title: Mount Vernon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a grassy, hilly landscape with trees around the edge and a wide river in the distance, dotted with small sailing ships. In the center of the painting is a stately white mansion on top of a green hill. To the right of the mansion, two couples walk along the grass by a white fence. Closer to us, in the bottom left corner, another couple walks arm in arm. The woman wears a long pink jacket over a white dress with a pink hat, and the man wears a dark blue coat over a yellow vest, with blue shorts over white stockings and a black hat on his head. Behind them, the wide river below stretches to the horizon. The sky above the scene is light blue and light pink, with purple clouds. The water of the river reflects these colors, and is mostly a soft, light pink.

artworks.title: Boy and Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Brothers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Two children are sitting side by side. The child on the left has short, brown hair, holds a book, and has a black cat on their lap. They wear a formal outfit and a straw hat lies on the grass near their feet. The child on the right has light blond, short hair, and holds an apple and a black hat. Both wear formal outfits. The background shows a landscape with hills, a scattered forest, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Miss Daggett of New Haven, Connecticut (possibly Amelia Martha)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Landscape with Buildings
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a green landscape seen from afar. In the distance, there are large white buildings partially obscured by tall leafy trees. Small people engage in leisure activities, such as walking along the grass, playing games, or sitting together. On the far left are two cows or horses in an open field. The color palette is mainly comprised of dark green, brown, and olive tones. The sky behind the trees is dark blue at the top of the painting, and transitions into a lighter yellow or peach color near the horizon.

artworks.title: Lady Undressing for a Bath
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The painting shows a woman and a man in a wood-paneled room. The woman is on the left, seated on a blue chaise lounge with carved wooden details. She is wearing a white blouse and a pink skirt, with one foot hovering above a basin of water. Her head is turned to the right. A small gray-and-brown dog is on the end of the chaise longue next to her. On the right, the man is entering the room, the pushing the wooden door open. He is holding a hat and is dressed in a blue tunic with white details, gray gloves, a red belt and red tights, and black shoes. They both have pale skin with rosy cheeks and red lips, and the woman has brown hair pulled back at the nape of her neck while the man has long gray curls. They are in a room with wood paneled walls and what looks like a heater on the far-left emitting steam.

artworks.title: Washington, the Mason
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing at the center. He is facing forward with his hands slightly raised at his sides. He has a serious expression and wears a tricorne hat. His hair is white or gray, styled beneath the hat. The man wears dark formal attire with a white collared shirt visible beneath, and a white apron with symbols. To his right, a column supports an object, and on his left, there's another column, a stone with a tool, and a small structure resembling a seat. The background has an archway with the letter 'G' displayed, and a patterned floor with golden and black designs. Surrounding the figure are brown and red tones.

artworks.title: "We Go for the Union"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting depicts a workshop scene where a large political poster is being created. On the left, a man stands at a worktable surrounded by tools and materials, including paint cans, brushes, and containers scattered around. He wears a tan vest over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up. On the right, two men stand next to a large white poster with the words "WE GO FOR THE UNION" above an oval portrait of a gray-haired man against a blue backdrop. The two men both seem to be painting the poster, with the man on the left holding a palette and a thin brush, and the man on the right holding a large can of white paint and a wide brush. The man on the left wears a tan coat and a yellow hat, while the man on the right has paint-covered overalls on over his white shirt and tie. The two men on the left have pale skin and clean-shaven faces, and we see them in profile. The man on the right looks out at us, and he has tan skin, a dark mustache, and a gray beard. In the center there is a window with a grid of rectangular panes, beyond which a vibrant orange and pink sky is visible.

artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Louis Husson
artworks.dimensions:
overall: 61 x 50.9 cm (24 x 20 1/16 in.)
framed: 76.2 x 66 x 6.7 cm (30 x 26 x 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katharine Husson Horstick
artworks.description: This painting shows a man from the chest up, positioned facing the right, gazing into the distance. The male has pale skin, a long nose, and deep-set eyes. He has dark, wavy hair, a pointed beard, and a mustache that hides his mouth. He is dressed in a dark green jacket with notched lapels, a white shirt, and a dark bow tie. The background is uniformly painted in a muted, warm brown tone.

artworks.title: Annie C. Lochrey Husson (Mrs. Louis Husson)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katharine Husson Horstick

artworks.title: George Dodd
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Albert M. Friend, Jr.
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man's upper body. The man is seated, facing to his left with a direct gaze. He has fair skin, a slender face with a prominent forehead, long nose, and slight smile. His dark, curly hair is receding at the temples. He wears a black coat, white shirt, and black necktie. There are no visible accessories. The background is a dark, muted brown color.
